status: Development feasibility on previously examined data. Recorded and committed before any filtered result was computed; that records the choice, it does not make the v1 history unseen. Not an independent validation, not a trading rule and not a change to protocol v1.
question: Does one causal market-breadth state, known at the decision time, separate protocol v1's decisions by their 24-hour outcome strongly and consistently enough to merit a separately designed future validation?

basis.observations: Protocol v1's own observations, rebuilt by the run commit's code from a git archive of 2d848fb and reconciled with the recorded split sizes, current fit and every validation and test aggregate, as in the diagnosis. No candle is downloaded.
basis.dataStatus: The whole v1 history has been examined by v1 and by the diagnosis. Every figure computed here is development evidence.

filter.members: All 20 protocol v1 members, in every decision
filter.returnFormula: r(pair, T) = close(T - 1h) / close(T - 25h) - 1, where close(X) is the close of the 1h candle opening at X
filter.information: Only those two 1h candles per pair, both closed by T. A candle is valid exactly as in protocol v1 (indexHourly: hour-aligned, close-time convention, no duplicate timestamp, valid prices). No candle opening at or after T is read.
filter.breadth: Number of members whose r is strictly greater than 0, divided by 20
filter.permitted: breadth > 0.50, that is 11 or more of 20: a long decision is permitted
filter.excluded: breadth <= 0.50, that is 10 or fewer of 20, exactly 10 included
filter.unavailable: If any member's required candle is missing or invalid, or its r is not finite, the state at T is UNAVAILABLE for every observation at T. Those observations belong to neither state and are counted; the denominator is never reduced below 20.
filter.notTuned: Lookback, threshold and direction are fixed here and are not changed after results are seen. No other filter is added.

keptFixed: Protocol v1's universe, decision grid and times, features and cells, six scenarios, entry, levels, outcome scan, AMBIGUOUS rule, costs, 24-hour horizon and the original split boundaries with their purge. v1's estimation, gates, ranking and qualification are neither re-run nor changed.

analysis.periodRule: Protocol v1's splitOf. A purged observation belongs to no period and is not analysed.

groups.permitted: Observations whose state at T is permitted
groups.excluded: Observations whose state at T is excluded
groups.unavailable: Observations whose state at T is unavailable: counted, never compared
groups.all: Every observation of the period, unavailable included

perGroup: coverage: the group's observations divided by all observations of the period
TARGET, STOP, TIMEOUT and AMBIGUOUS shares
mean gross return (exit / entry - 1 for v1's fill)
analysis.differences: Permitted minus excluded and permitted minus all, for the TARGET share, mean gross and mean net
analysis.targetRates: A group's TARGET share is a descriptive historical frequency of target before stop. It is not a validated probability for any current candidate.

months.key: Period and UTC calendar month of the decision; a month cut by a boundary appears once in each period
months.eligible: Both states have at least 30 observations in the month
months.reported: Per scenario: each state's observations, TARGET share, mean gross and mean net, and whether permitted mean gross exceeds excluded

uncertainty.method: Moving block bootstrap over UTC decision days. A position is a whole day with every pair and decision hour together, so the dependence between co-moving pairs and between overlapping labels inside a block is kept. Rows are never resampled individually.
uncertainty.positions: Every day the set can hold (protocol v1 splitDays); pooled uses splitDays('all')
uncertainty.draws: bootstrapOrders in scripts/swingStructureEvaluation.ts, with grid set to the set's name
uncertainty.pooled: Train, validation and test observations together

statistics.permittedMeanNet: Sum of permitted net returns divided by permitted observations over the resampled days
statistics.grossDifference: Permitted mean gross minus excluded mean gross over the resampled days

uncertainty.undefined: A replicate in which a state the statistic needs has no observation is undefined and counted
uncertainty.interval: Two-sided, Bonferroni over the six scenarios: percentiles alpha / (2 x 6) and 1 - alpha / (2 x 6), that is 0.4167 and 99.5833, type 7 quantiles
uncertainty.assumptions: Dependence longer than 7 days, such as regimes lasting months, is not reproduced; if it exists, the intervals are too narrow. Periods, the two statistics and the monthly breakdown are further comparisons that the adjustment does not cover. The intervals describe this examined history; they are not a validation.

decision.scope: The filter as a whole. No scenario is selected: every criterion must hold in all six scenarios.

evidence.rule: In each period, permitted and excluded each have at least 300 observations on at least 30 distinct days

separation.periods: Permitted mean gross > excluded mean gross in train, validation and test
separation.bound: The pooled interval's lower bound of permitted minus excluded mean gross > 0
separation.months: Permitted mean gross > excluded mean gross in at least two-thirds of the eligible months, and at least one month is eligible

decision.netReturn: Permitted mean net > 0 in train, validation and test

verdicts.when: Otherwise, a separation criterion fails in any scenario
Otherwise, the net-return criterion fails in any scenario: permitted decisions did better than excluded ones but still lost after costs
Every criterion holds in all six scenarios

decision.meaning: Only MERITS_SEPARATE_VALIDATION recommends designing a separate validation, frozen before a new untouched period. No verdict is a pass for live use, a trading rule or a change to v1's gates. Any other verdict ends this line of work: report it and stop, without searching for another rule.

output.results: .zerochart-reports/spot-24h-breadth-filter-<specification sha256, 12 hex>.json, written once; a rerun reports UNCHANGED or CONFLICT and never overwrites
output.identity: The result records the specification's SHA-256 (stableSerialize, as protocol v1), the code commit and blobs, the recorded result, the diagnostic output, the universe and every candle file's SHA-256
output.preserved: Protocol v1, its result, the diagnostic output and the saved market data are read, never written

notExecutionReady: Research only. No order, alert, account read, experiment record, schedule, download, deployment or production change.
